scope: Add a no-order, hash-bound append-only source-state contract for the C1 support/resistance geometry, with bounded profile/value-area reconstruction. This does not activate C1, H4, E2, MC1, portfolio, or exchange execution.

causality.source_state: The S/R state preserves active candidates, zone lifecycle, parent reaction/break aggregates, and unresolved interactions keyed by their own eight-hour resolution timestamp. A restored checkpoint cannot reinterpret them through a new dataframe row index.
causality.append: The state binds a 45-day completed-bar tail by SHA-256 plus a cumulative source-identity chain. It accepts overlap only as a complete chain-validated history or a fully retained bar-for-bar tail, and rejects a changed/off-tail unverifiable processed bar, a non-15-minute source gap, or a missing exact completed decision bar.
causality.profile: The retained C1-LVA seven-field profile block is reconstructed from its declared bounded completed-bar history and merged backward/as-of. Optional OI-at-price fields are not used by this retained level/value-area block.
causality.authority: The implementation emits target-free source snapshots only. It has no outcome, MC1, candidate admission, portfolio, exchange, or order authority.

validation.results: 18 focused tests passed. The append-state tests establish byte-identical later target-free S/R snapshots versus a single uninterrupted causal replay, save/load continuity, fail-closed in-tail rewrite and off-tail-overlap rejection, bounded completed-bar LVA context, and end-to-end target-free C1-LVA source scoring. The H4 exact economic gate remains rejected; no live activation occurred.
